game.name: Shell Shock: Live Action
game.desc: A side-scrolling beat-'em-up starring four live-action turtle brothers. Fight through 15 levels, from a burning apartment hallway and the sewers to a Wild West train, with multi-phase boss fights, throws, specials, pizza pickups, tag-in team play, three difficulty levels, a stage map, high scores and a gallery of every hero, boss and enemy. Progress and high scores are saved.

game.name: Street Fighter: World Brawl
game.desc: A fan-made street-brawler tour of the world. Pick one of 12 world warriors, each with their own stats and special move, and fight through stages starting at Ryu's Dojo, with mid-bosses and boss fights along the way. Stages 1-3 are playable now; the world map shows the rest of the tour as coming soon. Three difficulty levels and saved high scores.
